name: Payments
description: Stripe, charging, refunds and payment records.
takeaways: Charge manually, automatically or in bulk
Payment method sync is Stripe to Zenskar only

cards.title: Connect
cards.body: Under More, Integrations, Payment Gateways. Zenskar uses Stripe Connect, which is not compatible with Managed Payments. Each Stripe account connects once.
cards.example: Sandbox uses a test-mode Stripe account; production uses live mode.

cards.title: Customer sync
cards.body: Import only updates existing customers. Export only creates and updates Stripe customers. Import and Export does both.
cards.example: A new Zenskar customer is pushed to Stripe on creation.

cards.title: Payment settings
cards.body: Settings, Payment: card and net banking (US) options, save payment methods, show amount breakdown, and redirect URLs.
cards.example: Success URL returns customers to your app.

cards.title: Payment links
cards.body: Add a link when creating an invoice or later with Include Payment Link. Allow Partial Payment lets customers pay any amount up to the total. PAY ONLINE opens Stripe Checkout.

cards.title: Charging
cards.body: Manually with Charge Invoice, automatically with Enable Charge (default Stripe payment method), or in bulk from the invoice list.

cards.title: ACH credit transfer
cards.body: The payment is applied to the customer's oldest pending invoice first.
cards.example: A $2,000 transfer clears the oldest invoice, then the next.

cards.title: Types and status
cards.body: A payment record has a type of payment, refund or tax_withheld, a status, method, amount in the smallest currency unit and linked invoices.
cards.example: A refund links back to the original payment.

cards.title: Events
cards.body: Webhooks fire for payment.created, updated, succeeded, failed and refunded.

cards.title: Refunds
cards.body: A refund is created against an existing payment. Do not issue cash refunds against entitlements.

edgeCases: Export timing. Export pushes a customer to Stripe only when first created. Older customers need the bulk CSV import with a reference_id column.
Import never creates. Import only updates customers that exist on both sides.
One direction. Payment method sync runs from Stripe to Zenskar only.
Credit notes. Zenskar imports Stripe credit notes but does not create or push them.
Account rules. A Stripe account can be connected once, and should not already be connected to another platform such as Xero.
Entity is final. The Zenskar entity chosen for the connection cannot change after saving.
Environment match. Use a test-mode Stripe account for sandbox and live mode for production.

Which way do payment method changes sync?

qa.question: Import only vs export only vs import and export?
qa.answer: Import updates existing Zenskar customers from Stripe, export creates and updates Stripe customers, both does both.

qa.question: Manual vs automatic vs bulk charging?
qa.answer: Manual uses Charge Invoice, automatic uses Enable Charge with the default Stripe method, bulk charges many invoices as a background job.

qa.question: Payment vs refund vs tax_withheld?
qa.answer: They are payment record types: money received, money returned, and tax withheld by the payer.

qa.question: Payment link vs autocharge?
qa.answer: A link lets the customer choose how to pay; autocharge uses the saved default method.

qa.question: Card vs net banking vs ACH credit transfer?
qa.answer: Different payment methods. ACH credit transfers apply to the oldest pending invoice first.

qa.question: Full vs partial payment?
qa.answer: With Allow Partial Payment the customer can pay any amount up to the total.

qa.question: Stripe sandbox vs production?
qa.answer: Use a test-mode Stripe account with sandbox and live mode with production.

qa.question: Refund vs credit note?
qa.answer: A refund returns money for a payment. A credit note adjusts an invoice. Do not issue cash refunds against entitlements.

qa.question: Record a wire transfer?
qa.answer: Create a payment with a method such as bank_transfer, linked to the invoice.

qa.question: Refund one invoice of a multi-invoice payment?
qa.answer: Refund with payment-part amounts per invoice.

qa.question: Collect card details once and reuse them?
qa.answer: Save payment methods and use autocharge.

qa.question: Let customers pay online?
qa.answer: Include a payment link on the invoice.

qa.question: Write off after a refund?
qa.answer: The refund request has a writeoff_invoices option.

qa.question: Why was an old customer not exported to Stripe?
qa.answer: Export only pushes at first creation. Use bulk CSV import with reference_id.

qa.question: Does import create customers?
qa.answer: No. It only updates ones that exist.

qa.question: Which way do payment methods sync?
qa.answer: Stripe to Zenskar only.

qa.question: Credit notes created in Stripe?
qa.answer: They are imported but Zenskar does not push its own.

qa.question: Connect one Stripe account twice?
qa.answer: Blocked. Each account connects once, and it should not be connected to another platform.

qa.question: Change the entity after connecting?
qa.answer: The entity chosen cannot change after saving.

qa.question: Managed Payments?
qa.answer: Not compatible with Zenskar's Stripe Connect integration.

qa.question: What amount format do payments use?
qa.answer: Integers in the smallest currency unit.

qa.question: Which webhooks do payments fire?
qa.answer: payment.created, updated, succeeded, failed and refunded.
